domain: DesignJsonV1 only; XML aggregate retains separate format-specific semantic profile, not interchangeable by subtree extraction
entry: Only after adopted C1 guard has validated format/version/product_pass=false/duplicate/unknown/exact numeric representability; these vectors do not authorize unsupported input numbers.
projection: Remove only exact paths in semantic projection; original canonical payload keeps compatibility fields. Never omit same key name at another path.

object: list of [decoded key,typed value] sorted key UTF8 bytes

decimal: Exact base10 coefficient/exponent normalization: strip leading coefficient zeros, strip trailing zeros while increment exponent; zero canonical coefficient0/exponent0 including -0. No f64 proof or JS Number intermediate.
bytes: UTF8 no BOM/newline, compact JSON separators, string escape only quote/backslash and controls: standard short escape b/f/n/r/t when defined, otherwise lowercase u00xx; other valid Unicode scalars encoded literally, no surrogate values. Outer array [profile,typed semantic projection].
digest: sha256 of exact profile bytes, lowercase sha256:64hex. Raw file bytes/IO receipt digest remain separate.
migration: Adoption would amend pending M03-H2-D2 semantic byte recipe and M04 DesignJsonV1 recipe together. Do not overwrite either original review packet/revision silently. Existing accepted S1 raw digest syntax/state APIs unchanged; no existing persisted semantic baseline auto-reinterpreted.
owner_choice: Recommend this tagged shared profile to avoid serializer-specific number token spelling differences. Rejecting it requires another exact common byte profile before H2/M04 integration.
scope: Only M04 planning and own card evidence; affected M03 exact packet frozen/read-only; no cross-module implementation authority inferred.
